ideas.idea: Back up the 'thousands of patients' claim with a real figure or reviews
ideas.why: Accurate that the claim is unsupported, but this is general content advice with little technical effect on discoverability.

ideas.idea: Name the individual dentists on /team with qualifications and add Person structured data
ideas.why: team.njk only says 'decades of experience' with no names, so listing dentists would give readers and machines concrete entities.

ideas.idea: Show actual prices on /services or link to a pricing page
ideas.why: services.njk says 'prices are simple and clear' but shows none, so adding them gives users and machines a real answer.

ideas.idea: Give each service (implants, whitening) its own page
ideas.why: Services are bare list items in services.njk, so dedicated pages could answer specific queries.

ideas.idea: Add address and openingHours to the Dentist JSON-LD
ideas.why: The report claims contact.njk gives the address, but it only has the address in page text and the JSON-LD lacks it, while the cited line 7 is not the address and no opening hours exist anywhere to add.
True that there are no dates, but lastmod has little effect on a four-URL site.

ideas.idea: Add og:title and og:description social tags in base.njk
ideas.why: Accurate, but it is a standard recommendation that applies to almost any site.

ideas.idea: Add Organization or WebSite structured data on the home page
ideas.why: The only JSON-LD is on /contact, so the home page has no identity data and base.njk could carry it.

ideas.idea: Add a footer with phone and address to the base layout
ideas.why: base.njk has no footer, so contact details appear only on /contact, and a shared footer would expose them on every page.
